items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: And even Perez, I'd go to hear Perez. To me I'd go there more to hear the bass playing than anything else.

ctx.x: Yeah, I always did like the bass player. I remember long years ago I used to listen at the bass players and they used to use the bowl then, you see. I would sit down and listen at the music and to me I didn't hear anything else but the bass. My mind would be on it so much, you see. And that's just the way when I'd be sitting down and listening at any band or player, the first thing my ears would fall on is the bass. I mean that was even before I played the instrument. And even Perez, I'd go to hear Perez. To me…
Did he play string bass a good deal too? I knew he was a famous tuba player.
